name: TaxService
description: Creates a new TaxCode object (with associated existing or dynamically-created TaxRate objects) in QuickBooks Online.

operations.name: Create a taxservice
operations.description: Creates a new tax code and associates one or more tax rate specifications (existing or dynamically created) with it. Returns the newly created taxservice object.

requestBody.description: The minimum elements to create a taxservice object. RateValue must be between 0 and 100 (%). To use an existing tax rate, supply its TaxRateId (query the TaxRate resource for the Id); to dynamically create a new tax rate, omit TaxRateId and instead supply TaxRateName, RateValue and TaxAgencyId.

attributes.name: TaxCode
attributes.description: Name of the new tax code. To query the list of currently defined tax codes, use the TaxCode endpoint.

attributes.name: TaxRateDetails
attributes.description: Container to hold one or more tax rate specifications.

attributes.name: RateValue
attributes.description: The tax rate value as a percentage; must be between 0 and 100. A single tax rate may not be listed twice in the list.

attributes.name: TaxRateId
attributes.description: Id of an existing tax rate (query the TaxRate endpoint to determine the Id). Omit to dynamically create a new tax rate.

attributes.name: TaxApplicableOn
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax rate applies to Sales or Purchase.

attributes.name: TaxAgencyId
attributes.description: Id of the tax agency for the tax rate. The referenced TaxAgency must already exist.

attributes.name: TaxRateName
attributes.description: Name of the tax rate. Required when dynamically creating a new tax rate (i.e. when TaxRateId is not specified).

operations.note: On success the response includes the server-generated TaxCodeId and, for dynamically created rates, the generated TaxRateId. US-based QuickBooks companies only display system-created tax agencies and the tax rates visible via the QuickBooks UI.
